title: Return false payload values instead of nil

files.patch:
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ def initialize(payload)
       end
 
       def [](key)
-        value = @payload[key] || @payload[key.to_s] || @payload[key.to_sym]
+        value = fetch_value(key)
 
         value.is_a?(Hash) ? self.class.new(value) : value
       end
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ def key?(key)
       def method_missing(method_name, *arguments)
         return super unless arguments.empty? && !block_given?
 
-        value = @payload[method_name] || @payload[method_name.to_s] || @payload[method_name.to_sym]
+        value = fetch_value(method_name)
         value.is_a?(Hash) ? self.class.new(value) : value
       end
 
@@ -43,6 +43,14 @@ def respond_to_missing?(method_name, include_private = false)
       end
 
       def to_h = @payload
+
+      private
+
+      def fetch_value(key)
+        found = [key, key.to_s, key.to_s.to_sym].find { @payload.key?(it) }
+
+        @payload[found] unless found.nil?
+      end
     end
   end
 end

@@ -52,6 +52,21 @@ def setup
       assert_equal "John", payload_with_symbols.dig(:customer, :name)
     end
 
+    test "returns false values instead of nil" do
+      payload = { "livemode" => false, "data" => { "object" => { "paid" => false } } }.to_dot
+
+      assert_equal false, payload.livemode
+      assert_equal false, payload["livemode"]
+      assert_equal false, payload[:livemode]
+      assert_equal false, payload.data.object.paid
+      assert_equal false, { paid: false }.to_dot["paid"]
+    end
+
+    test "returns nil for a missing key" do
+      assert_nil @payload.nonexistent
+      assert_nil @payload["nonexistent"]
+    end
+
     test "supports key? method" do
       assert @payload.key?("id")
       assert @payload.key?("type")
